notes.title: Community Tournament
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41623202/0b0178038682fb396a718d98566de0e15a068794.png
[hr][/hr]
Attention, pilots!

We are excited to announce our very first Community Tournament! Whether you are a new or veteran pilot, it's time to bring out the champion in you. 

When?
Friday, May 27th, at 1 pm CST. 
 
Prizes

 1st place - $50 Steam Gift Cards to each player of the team
 2nd place - $30 Steam Gift Cards to each player of the team
 3rd place - $10 Steam Gift Cards to each player of the team

How to join?
It's easy! Just fill out this registration form.
Registration will be open until Friday, May 27th, at 10 am CST.

Format
For the sake of time, the format will be double elimination. As the name suggests, a team will be eliminated after losing two matches.

Teams
Team size will be decided depending on how many people register. Teams will be made randomly, but you can specify which players you'd like to be paired with in the form above. 

Don't forget to request your early access so that you can join the tournament!
Also, please join our Discord. It is always important to have communication with your squad.

See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Core Briefing February/March
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41623202/a64bfbc83e36b61d9346b0c8baf67e91cab72f86.png
[hr][/hr]
Attention everyone!

Welcome to our newest Core Briefing for February and March!

Our team has been extremely busy recently, and we’re excited to announce what we’ve been working on! There are plenty of new additions, fixes and features to talk about. So hold tight, and let’s get into Patch 3.16 together!

-Matchmaking-
We’ve added some Multiplayer quality of life features to the Matchmaking interface and backend to give Pilots more information and a smoother experience:

 Added player count to the matchmaking queue for game mode
 Implement a mechanism in the lobby to “select the best host” for the game session based on lowest average ping to all players
 Added host migration options to help Pilots experience the smoothest game possible

-Gameplay-
Additions and tweaks to the moment to moment gameplay to adjust the feeling of your vehicles:

 “Graphics performance” warning issue resolved
*] Reduced all armor hit points by approximately 50%

-Controls-
We’ve expanded the controller compatibility of Core Disruption to include new hardware:

 Implemented hand controller support

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41623202/c31819496d460967b6b38607763681dba89f2b91.png
-Hangar-
The backend performance of the Hangar has been optimized:

 Setup engines for engine power settings
 Setup engines to prepare for custom engine implementation
 Implemented save/delete/modify loadouts feature, which can be selected while matchmaking
 Your last known valid loadout can now be saved
 4 default loadouts for each vehicle with the option to purchase up to 10 additional loadout slots
 Hangar teleport UI improvement that displays input requirement when highlighted

-Vehicles-
The handling of several vehicles have been adjusted, as well as the sounds inside and out of the cockpit:

 Talon speed, acceleration, and turn rate adjusted.
 Updated weapon firing sounds for rail guns and flak cannons. 
 Implemented internal versions of weapon sounds for RL2, RL4, FC2, FC4, HVB54. 
 Lowered overall engine volumes across all vehicles.
 Damage display updates to indicate when player is at low health on certain components
 Implemented new collision sound effects
 Total loadout weight now factors into the top speed / acceleration / turn rate of the hover tanks

-Market-
The Marketplace has been opened further for Pilots to express themselves:

 Cockpit themes implemented

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41623202/a8d53d5d888820d997e2ed735fb5657e5698e886.png
-Weapons-
Our weapon systems have been adjusted to provide clearer feedback to the pilots and change how they interact with opponents' vehicles:

 Added back hitmarkers and hitmarker sound
 Weapon buttons redesigned to prominently display their weight
 Weapons now deal a different amount of damage to the armor than they do to the core
 Implemented new Rail Gun sound effect
 Modified beam weapon heat generation rate to be proportional to the drum spin speed
 Added 160mm cannon, which fires a projectile with bullet drop
 Added MR-5 rocket launcher, which fires rockets that accelerate at a constant rate

-Progression-
We reworked how the game presents the players combat rewards:

 Updated postgame credit animation improved.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41623202/4130184dc0340c2ac9670c12a78a1a337cdf4470.png
-Maps-
finally, saving the best for last, we’ve added a new backdrop for your vehicles:

 New hangar map

-Debriefing-
That’s it for this month’s Core Briefing! Thank you for taking the time to read us, and we hope you liked it! Make sure to join us on Discord and to tell us what you think there!

See you next time,
-The Core Disruption Team

notes.title: Core Briefing for January
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/16yiPZ6.gif

ATTENTION!
Welcome to CORE BRIEFING for January!

      We have been busy working on some new additions and improvements for Core Disruption for you, the players! For our first Core Briefing in 2022, we are excited to show you some fixes we brought to combat, matchmaking, weapons and overall experience improvements.

 If you have any feedback or requests, please make them heard in the Steam Discussions and/or our Discord.

Now let’s get to the briefing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41623202/665b6f231e37632360fd2729a831c1a82809931b.png
-Combat-
	This month we worked on some key improvements to combat which include hand controller support and sound changes.
 First passthrough newly developed hand controller support 
 Overall sound improvements to weapons, engines, and cockpit UI
 In-tank and post-death menu added that supports numerous types of input devices
 Explosions upon death
 Spectator mode upon death redesigned
-Matchmaking-
Some things in matchmaking have improved and hope with feedback from the community will make it even better.
 Improved UI functionality
 Matchmaking region selection
 Party invites to friends functioning
 Party and lobby voice chat implemented
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41623202/8cac832e72b43644d35a7daf6dd4e4597f724a54.png
-Vehicles-
Vehicles have also had some minor fixes in hopes to bring players the best feel when out on the battlefields.
 Physics improvements
 Hover height adjusted
 Speed adjustments to Talon
 Engine sound improvements
-Weapons-
	Some minor fixes have been implemented for the in-game weapons and more will be looked into as we push forward.
 Players are now able to unequip weapons from any chassis they own.
 Overheat visual + audio effect
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41623202/0ef5f22b1270c9392f1d9c3556d344faa66c2e9b.png
-Hangar-
The hanger has had some improvements with everything from UI improvements and being able to set your default tank.
 The market now lists all current weapons with 6 types (4 classes of weapons)
 Beam Lasers
 Bolters
 Railguns
 Flak Cannons
 Autocannons
 Autobolters
 UI improved visually and with new input features
 Teleport now requires input to initiate upon full
 Skins now implemented
 The loadout system lets you save a configuration for each chassis.
 There’s a ring around the selected tank in the hangar to let you know if you’re on a trial tank.
 Can set a tank to be your default tank now.
-Market-
We brought some changes to the market to hopefully help players navigate and use the market easier in-game.
 General UI improvements
 Skins are now listed as purchasable through Core Credits
 Market UI has new visuals and updated animations
 The market has a miniature cart preview
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41623202/1745180a118c7a381cd14cdbc950305657583438.png
-Progression-
Some minor fixes and improvements were implemented and we hope the community will enjoy them.
 General UI improvements
 Can earn credits + XP (often resets for new builds)
 Added in match specific post-game stats
-Controls-
We brought some simple fixes to help with motion sickness and to toggle reticles.
 Optional input toggle between the master reticle and direct-input
 Additional options for motion sickness reduction with a vignette effect
-Bugfixes-
 Quick and simple bug fixes this time around with some alignment adjustments and particle lag.
 Zoom Camera Alignment
 Particle related lag fix for autocannon
-Debriefing-
We have much more planned going forward for 2022 and hope to bring you monthly updates on everything from fixes, patches and additions to the game and community. We are very thankful for you all to join us on this journey in Core Disruption!

So once again, feel free to give us feedback and ideas on the Steam Discussions and/or our Discord.
 
- The Core Disruption Team

notes.title: Core Disruption Closed Beta
notes.content:
We are now running a closed beta of Core Disruption! If you are interested in participating, head to our website to sign up. A member of our development team will reach out to let you know if there are spots remaining.

Sign up for the closed beta

A few notes on the form:

 Name: We do not need your real name. Just enter whatever you'd like to be called
 Discord User: To participate, you'll need to join the Core Disruption Discord Server
 Platform: Select SteamVR and enter your steam profile URL (or Steam ID)

If you have any problems signing up, message scubasteve in our Discord Server

Details

 If you are chosen to participate in the closed beta, we will send you a Steam key
 Scheduling will be coordinated through our Discord Server in the #beta-testing channel
 Feedback can be given at our beta-support page
 Beta testers are allowed to post/stream any recorded content on external platforms (YouTube, Twitch, etc.)

We are excited to share this game with the world, and can't wait to incorporate feedback from the community!
